title: Red car with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Car body -->
  <rect x='10' y='50' width='80' height='26' rx='10' fill='#ff3b3b'/>
  <!-- Roof cabin -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q33 32 50 32 Q67 32 70 50 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- Windows -->
  <path d='M35 48 Q38 37 50 37 Q62 37 65 48 Z' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <!-- Windshield divider -->
  <rect x='49' y='36' width='2' height='12' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
  <!-- Smiling face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='60' r='5' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='60' r='2.4' fill='#1a2b55'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='60' r='5' fill='#8fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='60' r='2.4' fill='#1a2b55'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 66 Q50 76 60 66' stroke='#8fe3ff' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ffb3b3'/>
  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='78' r='4' fill='#9fb0e0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='9' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='78' r='4' fill='#9fb0e0'/>
  <!-- Headlights -->
  <rect x='12' y='54' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <rect x='81' y='54' width='7' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffe680'/>
</svg>
